title: reconstruction_tests
summary: A research codebase implementing measures related to the "Fundamental Law of Information Recovery," a concept from privacy/reconstruction-attack theory. Its ctgan_builds module builds synthetic tables for testing by fitting SDV's CTGANSynthesizer on source dataframes, with metadata inferred via SDV's Metadata class.
needs: README is minimal; broader purpose of the reconstruction-attack test suite and how CTGAN-built synthetic data feeds into it is not fully documented.
